interface.signature: say_hello(name: list[str], city: str, state: str) -> str

preconditions.description: The `name` list must contain at least one string.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, str) for n in name)
preconditions.description: Every element in `name` must be a string.

postconditions.description: The output string must be a greeting combining the joined `name` elements, `city`, and `state` in the exact format: 'Hello, [joined_name]! Welcome to [city], [state]!'
